$comment: Source of truth for feature state. feat-001..010 = Phase 1 (MVP) in docs/SPEC.md; feat-011 = Phase 1 follow-up; feat-012..020 = Phase 2 (planned 2026-11-05, start only when the owner says so; trial feedback from feat-009 may reorder). Status: not-started | in-progress | blocked | done. Only one feature in-progress at a time. 'done' requires evidence (command + result).

features.name: Project setup
features.description: Install Flutter SDK, run `flutter create --org com.vocaswiper --platforms=android,ios .` to generate platform folders, git init. Done when: ./init.sh passes and the app boots on an iOS simulator and an Android emulator.
features.evidence: 2026-11-04: ./init.sh green (format 0 changed, analyze no issues, 1/1 test). Android: flutter build apk --debug OK, boots on Medium_Phone_API_37.0 emulator. iOS: flutter build ios --simulator OK (Xcode 27.2, CocoaPods 1.17.0), boots on iPhone 18 Pro simulator (iOS 27.2). Screenshots checked.

features.name: SM-2 scheduler (domain)
features.description: Pure-Dart SRS in lib/core/srs/: word states New → Learning → Review → Mastered, intervals 1d → 3d → prev × ease (default 2.5, lowered by misses), Mastered at interval ≥ 21d, any miss → Learning, quiz wrong overrides 'knew it'. Done when: unit tests cover every transition and interval rule.
features.evidence: 2026-11-04: ./init.sh green — format 0 changed, analyze no issues, 25/25 tests (test/core/srs/sm2_scheduler_test.dart covers New→Learning, Learning→Review, Review→Mastered, Mastered stays, miss→Learning from any state, 1→3→×ease ladder, almost < knew, ease floor 1.3, quiz-wrong override; test/core/core_purity_test.dart guards lib/core imports).

features.name: Session builder (domain)
features.description: Builds a daily session: due reviews oldest first, then new words up to the profile's daily goal, 'didn't know' cards re-queued at the end. Done when: unit tests cover ordering, daily-goal cap and re-queue.
features.evidence: 2026-11-04: ./init.sh green — format 0 changed, analyze no issues, 43/43 tests. test/core/session/session_builder_test.dart covers due-first oldest-first ordering (+ id tie-break), not-yet-due excluded, Mastered resurfacing, daily-goal cap incl. earlier sessions today, reviews uncapped, skip candidates with progress/duplicates, miss re-queue once at end, first-answer-only scheduling, immutability.

features.name: Local database + word bank
features.description: Drift schema for Word, Translation, ParentAccount, Profile, WordProgress, SessionLog. Bundled read-only word bank (asset SQLite) for Pre-A1 + A1 with Vietnamese translations; content_pipeline script builds it. Done when: repository tests read words and write progress against an in-memory DB; bundled DB loads on device.
features.evidence: 2026-11-04: ./init.sh green — analyze no issues, 74/74 tests (word_bank_builder_test: asset up to date, validation errors; word_bank_importer_test: import/version skip/upsert; repositories_test: candidates order + filters, progress roundtrip + firstSeenAt, cascade delete, file DB restart persistence). Device: app imports bundled bank on Android API 37 emulator and shows '392 words ready'. Decision: docs/adr/0001.

features.name: Parent account + child profiles
features.description: PIN-protected parent area; create/edit/delete child profiles (name, avatar, age, native language, level, daily goal, swipe direction); profile picker on home. Done when: two profiles keep independent settings across app restarts; PIN stored hashed.
features.evidence: 2026-11-04: ./init.sh green — analyze no issues, 78/78 tests. test/data/repositories_test.dart: two profiles keep independent settings across a file-DB restart; PIN stored salted+hashed, verify/changePin. test/features/profiles_flow_test.dart: first-run PIN setup → add child → picker; PIN gate rejects wrong PIN, locks on exit; editing one profile leaves the other; delete with confirm; picker opens child home. Device (Android API 37 emulator): fresh install → create PIN → add 'Bi' → force-stop + relaunch → profile still listed → PIN unlocks parent area.

features.name: Swipe flashcard session
features.description: Swipe right = knew, left = didn't know (parent can flip), optional up = almost; tap to flip showing picture, word, device-TTS audio, example, translation; session summary with stars. Answers feed the SM-2 scheduler. Done when: a full session updates WordProgress correctly, verified by widget test + manual run on phone and tablet.
features.evidence: 2026-11-05: ./init.sh green — analyze no issues, 99/99 tests. test/features/session_controller_test.dart: full session saves WordProgress (knew/almost/miss ease + counts, retry not scheduled), session log, quit keeps progress, next-day reviews first, daily goal across sessions. test/features/session_flow_test.dart: buttons + swipes (right/left/up), short drag springs back, flipped direction, flip shows translation, tap-to-reveal mode, quit, tablet layout. Device: flutter drive integration_test/session_on_device_test.dart (real word bank, device TTS) passed on iPhone 18 Pro and iPad Pro 13 simulators (iOS 27.2); screenshots checked; WordProgress asserted (5 words, dog wrongCount 1, bird ease 2.35). Android emulator not used (stuck on systemui update screen).

features.name: Daily reminder notification
features.description: One local notification per day at a parent-picked time, only when reviews are due, kid-friendly wording, respects quiet hours. Done when: notification fires on device when reviews are due and is skipped when none are.
features.evidence: 2026-11-05: ./init.sh green — analyze no issues, 126/126 tests. test/core/reminders/reminder_planner_test.dart (11): off, nothing due, one per day for a week, waits until words are due, time passed → tomorrow, school hours move to school end on weekdays only, quiet hours skip (overnight + same-day windows), several children in one message. test/features/reminders_flow_test.dart (5): parent turns on → permission asked, 18:00 default, scheduled with kid wording; nothing due → nothing scheduled; off → cancelled; permission denied → parent told; finishing a session re-plans (reviewed words stop the nudge). Device: flutter drive integration_test/reminder_on_device_test.dart on iPhone 18 Pro and iPad Pro 13 simulators — nothing due → 0 pending; due → 7 pending, waited for the first: iOS delivered 'Bi, 1 word is waiting to say hi!' (getActiveNotifications) and pending dropped to 6. Android: same test on emulator Medium_Phone_API_37.0 (Android 17) after a cold boot, POST_NOTIFICATIONS granted via adb — passed, reminder delivered 80s after the planned time (inexact alarm, expected).

features.name: Progress screen per profile
features.description: Words mastered / learning, accuracy, minutes per day for each profile. Done when: numbers match SessionLog and WordProgress data in a widget test.
features.evidence: 2026-11-05: ./init.sh green — analyze no issues, 136/136 tests. test/core/progress/progress_stats_test.dart (5): empty profile, counts by state (new excluded), accuracy weighted by answers, minutes per local day for 7 days, short sessions ≥ 1 min. test/features/progress_flow_test.dart (5): numbers on screen match seeded WordProgress (2 mastered/1 review/3 learning) and SessionLogs (9 of 12 right → 75%, 5 + 3 min) from child home and from the parent area; other profiles don't leak; new child shows zeros; numbers update after a session; tablet layout. Device: integration_test/session_on_device_test.dart opens My words after a real session on iPhone 18 Pro and iPad Pro 13 simulators (5 learning, 80%, 1 min) — passed, screenshots checked. 2026-11-05 Android emulator (Android 17): same test passed (01:31) after fixing an audioplayers frame loop (positionUpdater = null in lib/ui/sfx.dart), phone screenshots checked.

features.name: Kid-friendly visual design + delight pass
features.description: Make the child-facing screens (profile picker, child home, session, summary, and the progress screen once it exists) look and feel made for kids: a playful colour palette and rounded display font, illustrated backgrounds and a friendly mascot on home and summary, bigger pictures on cards, satisfying motion (card entrance, swipe feedback, correct/miss reactions, star/confetti celebration via lottie or rive), optional short sound effects, and tablet scaling (type, card and buttons grow with screen size instead of staying phone-sized). Age band adjusts style (4–6 bigger and simpler, 7+ less babyish). Parent area gets a cleaner, calmer look but stays simple. Out of scope (Phase 3): streaks, badges, word garden, games. All assets bundled offline with a confirmed free license. Done when: before/after screenshots on phone and tablet for every child screen are reviewed and accepted by the owner; animations run smoothly on device; reduced-motion setting respected; ./init.sh green.
features.evidence: 2026-11-05: owner reviewed the before/after screenshots and accepted. ./init.sh green — analyze no issues, 110/110 tests. test/features/kid_look_test.dart: age band → look (4–6 sunny, 7+ adventure), tablet scale factor, answer/summary sounds, confetti bursts once, reduced motion → no confetti, parent sound toggle persists. test/data/settings_repository_test.dart: sound setting default on, persisted, streamed. Device: flutter drive integration_test/session_on_device_test.dart passed on iPhone 18 Pro and iPad Pro 13 simulators with real sounds + TTS; before/after screenshots in docs/design/feat-010/ (compare-phone.jpg, compare-tablet.jpg).

features.name: Phase 1 gate — real-use trial
features.description: Owner's child uses the app 5 days a week for 2 weeks without being pushed. Human gate: only the owner can mark this done.

features.name: Session budget for review backlogs
features.description: DECISION PENDING (owner). Reviews are uncapped today: a simulation with the real scheduler shows sessions grow to ~40 cards by week 3 of daily use, ~50 on Mondays after weekends off, ~100 after a 10-day break and ~200 after a 3-week holiday. The profile's 'minutes per day' setting is stored but not enforced. Proposed: a per-session card budget from the profile's daily minutes; most-overdue reviews first, the rest wait for tomorrow; no new words on a catch-up day. Done when: no session exceeds the budget; the backlog drains over the following days in a simulation test; new words pause while behind.

features.name: P2: Active-recall quiz round
features.description: After the swipe cards, a short quiz over today's words (docs/SPEC.md — Session flow step 4): pick the picture (4+), choose the meaning from four options, letter-tile spelling (7+). A wrong quiz answer overrides a 'knew it' swipe (resolveAnswer, AnswerQuality.quizWrong). Kid-styled, sounds and stars like the swipe cards. Done when: widget tests show the quiz round, the override rescheduling a word, and the summary counting quiz results; checked on phone and tablet.

features.name: P2: Retention tracking
features.description: Log every quiz answer (new QuizLog table + migration) and compute 'remembered after 2 weeks': quiz accuracy on words first learned 14+ days earlier, per profile. Feeds the parent dashboard and the Phase 2 gate. Done when: unit tests on the metric; numbers match seeded logs in a widget test.

features.name: P2: Content — A1 top-up, A2–B1 words, grammar forms
features.description: Grow the bank via content_pipeline: top up Pre-A1/A1 toward the ~1,000 words the Phase 1 SPEC targets (392 today), add A2–B1 words (word, definition, example, forms, themes, Vietnamese drafts; pictures optional at these levels), syllables with stress where cheap. Translation fades by level (already the default per level). Done when: pipeline tests pass, bank version bumps and imports on upgrade without touching progress, A2/B1 cards render on phone and tablet.

features.name: P2: Placement test + favourite themes
features.description: Onboarding for a new profile (docs/SPEC.md — Onboarding): 20–30 words sampled across levels from the age default, know / don't know with a picture check every few words to catch guessing; start level where ~70%+ are known; the child picks favourite themes, which are preferred for new words; first mini-session of 5 easy words. Parent can skip or override. Done when: unit tests on level choice and anti-guessing; widget test of the whole flow; checked on phone and tablet.

features.name: P2: Automatic level progression
features.description: Move up a level when 80% of the current level's words are mastered (parent can override or lock); mix a few next-level preview words into daily batches; if accuracy stays under 50% for a week, suggest stepping back to the parent. Done when: unit tests for the rules; widget test shows the level-up celebration and the parent suggestion.

features.name: P2: Parent dashboard
features.description: Per profile in the parent area: struggling words (most misses), weekly trend (words learned and minutes for the last 4–8 weeks), minutes vs the daily goal, 'remembered after 2 weeks' %, current level with override. Done when: numbers match seeded data in widget tests; checked on phone and tablet.

features.name: P2: Custom word lists
features.description: Parents add words from homework or books: matched to the bank when present; otherwise the parent types a short definition and translation and picks an emoji; audio comes from device TTS. Custom words are introduced first as new words. Done when: repository + widget tests for add/match/edit/delete; custom words appear in the next session; per-profile.

features.name: P2: Weekly recap
features.description: A 'This week' card on the child home (words learned, minutes, a word of the week) plus an optional weekly notification; includes 1–2 mastered words to recall so they don't fade (SPEC — Knowledge reminders). Done when: unit tests for the recap content; widget test; notification planned once a week within quiet/school rules.

features.name: Phase 2 gate — retention check
features.description: Quiz accuracy shows words are retained after 2 weeks (docs/SPEC.md — Phase 2 gate), read from the feat-013 metric during real use. Human gate: only the owner can mark this done.
